assets.subject: Notre-Dame eteläjulkisivu
assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup / photorealistic architectural texture projection. Produce ONE entirely new high-detail photographic surface image for planar projection onto an owner's simplified Notre-Dame model. Every surface is freshly generated; do not paste or repeat photo patches. The first three inputs are ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY constraints: image1 is the exact clean model orthographic view/frame; image2 is the exact white building-silhouette mask; image3 is the exact white aperture mask. KEEP this precise MODEL, its full canvas, outline, proportions, feature positions and aperture centers. Do not repair the simplified model into real-world canonical Notre-Dame architecture. Subsequent photos are ONLY material/color/wear references; ignore their perspective, composition, sky, foreground, background, sunlight and cast shadows. Real-camera-like fine material texture, not a drawing/illustration/cartoon/CGI surface, but rigorously ORTHOGRAPHIC with zero perspective or tilt. Same canvas framing as image1: absolutely no auto centering, fitting, crop, padding, invented margins, rotation or perspective. Preserve every tower, ridge, eave, cornice, buttress, pinnacle and aperture at its exact input pixel-normalized location. Every aperture is on a WHITE input3 mask region; no invented openings and no omitted existing ones. Return a true transparent PNG cutout, genuine alpha outside the white building mask and through existing silhouette holes; no checkerboard drawn into pixels. Photographic restored pale creamy-yellow limestone with individually varied stones and fine mortar, natural non-repeating mineral variation and subtle dirt/runoff streaks; no soot-black look. Pale SILVER-GREY lead roofs, darker blue-grey spire, softly greenish verdigris bronze statues. PERFECTLY EVEN diffuse overcast illumination, no sun, no directional highlights, no cast/projected/ground/contact/AO shadows baked in; only natural dark depth inside openings. No people, vehicles, trees, cranes, scaffolding, utility poles, street lamps, signs, sky, ground, text, letters, numbers, watermarks, caption, ruled/grid lines or reference annotations. Model edges become real material joints, never drawn outline strokes. No repeated tiles, copy-paste blocks or clone patches. This is a high-detail material atlas, not an artistic reconstruction of a different cathedral. All detailed material must be subordinate to EXACT pixel-normalized geometry.
View: SOUTH ELEVATION, facade square-on ORTHOGRAPHIC, azimuth26degrees, no camera tilt. Exact clean-frame aspect4088:2981 (1.37135), intended minimum4088x2981 PNG. At the LEFT is the visible south-side wall of ONE west tower with its slatted belfry openings exactly where input masks place them; long nave/choir wall runs horizontally toward right. Central existing spire/lead crossing roof stays in its exact silhouette position; do not generate a separate spire view. Flying buttresses and pinnacles at RIGHT stay exactly on model shapes. The facade's defined pointed windows (including11 A-type2.25x7.75m and3 B-type2.25x11.75m, plus other mask types) retain exact counts/shapes/margins and masks; no large circular rose window, no extra doors/windows in blank lower stone wall, no invented decorative gallery openings. Cornice/eave bands exactly at the clean model's heights. Real restored creamy limestone face with individual courses and unique weathering, subtle stone relief and restrained mortar, photographic slate/lead/bronze surfaces. Preserve the model's low exterior wall/roof arrangement and incomplete buttress overlaps, without changing geometry. Geometry must be identical to image1 and masks; only full material appearance changes.
